items.title: GitHub - coderjatin/anti-slop-writing: Improve AI text to sound natural, clear, and human-like by reducing stiffness and enhancing specificity for multiple AI writing tools. · GitHub
items.snippet: anti-slop-writing is a system prompt designed to stop your AI from writing in a predictable, robotic way. It detects and removes typical AI writing patterns, making the output feel more human. This tool works with many large language models (LLMs) and AI assistants.
